name: agent-pane
description: An IDE-style side pane for Claude Code: the agent's avatar and live activity, turn time with an estimate, context, usage, limits, the prompt-cache countdown and subagents, in collapsible sections.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: Icon set: auto uses Nerd Font icons when such a font is installed here; plain uses Unicode only.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: on: the robot face draws at the top of the pane when there is room. off: a two-line head instead.

start.title: Open at start
start.description: on: the pane opens when a session starts and seats itself at your first prompt. off: it stays closed until you run /agent-pane.
